description: This file defines the HomeScreen widget, which serves as the main interface for a note-taking app. It manages displaying, searching, sorting, editing, and deleting notes, utilizing various Flutter widgets and provider for state management.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: Main widget representing the note list screen with search, sort, and note management functionalities.

classes.name: _HomeScreenState
classes.description: State class for HomeScreen managing UI state, user interactions, and integration with providers.

classes.name: _SectionHeader
classes.description: Widget displaying section headers within the notes list.

classes.name: _EmptyState
classes.description: Widget displayed when there are no notes to show.

classes.name: _DismissibleNote
classes.description: Wrapper for each note that enables swipe-to-delete functionality.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state; loads notes on startup.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up controllers when the widget is disposed.

methods.name: _openEditor
methods.description: Opens the note editor screen for creating or editing a note.

methods.name: _confirmDelete
methods.description: Asks user for confirmation before deleting a note.

methods.name: _openBottomSheet
methods.description: Displays a bottom sheet with note options (edit, pin, delete).

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI of the HomeScreen, including app bar, note list, and actions.
